prior_outcome_acknowledgement: Parent 9600-world Hoeffding first result already seen, including 0.815 power for strong effect at n=1000 and deterministic CP early certification at n=200. This is a separate prospective paired comparison; no blinded discovery claim.

sampling.paired_seed_process: Same original NumPy SeedSequence([2026100914, truth_index, n_index, replicate_index]); four Binomial q successes drawn before one Fisher-noncentral observed animal-table draw, shared by CP and Hoeffding.

methods.Hoeffding: Reuse exact same frozen previous source module simultaneous four-cell Hoeffding alpha_cal=.025
methods.CP: Exact per-cell two-sided Clopper-Pearson with beta quantile lower=BetaPPF(alpha_cal/8,S,n-S+1) if S>0 else 0; upper=BetaPPF(1-alpha_cal/8,S+1,n-S) if S<n else 1
methods.implementation: scipy.special.betaincinv for exact regularized incomplete Beta quantile. Optional test-only dependency in isolated workflow, not a change to ODSP requirements.
methods.q_gamma_upper: (fall_early_q_upper * rise_late_q_upper)/(rise_early_q_lower*fall_late_q_lower) or HOLD if any q denominator <=0
methods.robust_test: One-sided nonrandomized Fisher noncentral upper-tail using same original animal data at effort_OR*gamma_upper, reject when p<0.025
methods.reference_gold_standard: External independent labeled true animal-passage opportunities assumed perfect and representative; assumption not verified on EcoBank

counts from source fixed season and bin margins exactly in every world

post_result_constraint: If tests fail, repair only proven numerical/programming errors, preserve failed CI logs and frozen design; do not tune n, q, effect, alpha or seed based on first CP results.
